```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set the style of the visualization
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a countplot to show the survival count by passenger class and sex
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
ax = sns.countplot(data=df, x='pclass', hue='sex', palette='pastel')

# Set labels and title
ax.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
ax.set_title('Survival Count by Passenger Class and Sex', fontsize=14)

# Add legend
ax.legend(title='Sex', title_fontsize='13', fontsize='11')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
